name: vistep-scene
title_zh: 自然语言直接产出可审稿的 vistep 视觉解说
tagline_zh: 不用先学 vistep 语法，说人话就能生成科学动画。从调研到双语旁白全包，还带独立美术方向和审稿闭环。
tagline_en: Skip the vistep syntax. Describe what you want and get a researched, art-directed, bilingual-narrated animation.
desc_en: Create or refine vistep.ai visual explanations from a natural-language request, covering research, independent art direction, scientific models, automatic films, bilingual narration, integration and review. Also use for the site's brand animation and original showcase artwork when part of this production workflow.
why_zh: 把「研究—分镜—建模—旁白—审稿」串成一条流水线，且每一步都留人工确认口，不是黑箱生成。
why_en: It's a full pipeline—research, storyboard, modeling, narration, review—with human checkpoints at every stage. Not a black box; a.
limit_zh: 只产出 vistep.ai 项目文件，不含最终视频渲染。需要你本地有 vistep 环境或网页版账号。
limit_en: Outputs vistep project files only, no final video render. Requires local vistep env or web account. Scientific models need your formulas/data; no.
